title: Jailbroken Frontier Models Retain Their Capabilities
reasoning: The paper focuses on the 'jailbreak tax,' which refers to the performance degradation of LLMs (specifically the Claude model family) when subjected to adversarial jailbreaking attacks. It evaluates model capabilities on scientific reasoning benchmarks like GPQA and WMDP Bio, but it does not evaluate religion, faith, theology, or specific philosophical moral/ethical reasoning frameworks.
